countries.reasoning: China is the largest producer of titanium minerals and concentrates, supported by USGS 2024 and industry reports; data is recent and highly reliable.
Australia is a major titanium mineral producer primarily from ilmenite and rutile, per USGS 2024 data; production figures are well-documented.
India produces significant ilmenite and rutile as reported by Geological Survey of India and USGS; data is reliable but sometimes less frequently updated.
South Africa is a key producer of titanium minerals, with data from the Mineral Council South Africa and USGS 2024; production somewhat consistent but subject to market fluctuations.
Ukraine is among top producers of titanium mineral concentrate (ilmenite); data is based on recent production reports but affected by geopolitical factors that may influence accuracy.
